title: Marketplace go-live playbook and copy sandbox
body:
Purpose:
This is a go-to-market + ops playbook for partner listings in cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP). It combines an operational runway checklist, copy sandbox (tile + long description + feature bullets), trial/entitlement quirks, billing/contract constraints, and a simple risk/rollback plan. Aim: reduce last-minute rework during vendor certification and make the listing copy experiment-friendly.

Scope:
- Partners and internal PMs engineering the marketplace listing (tile + detail page + entitlements)
- Staging verification, telemetry, legal/billing gating, and A/B copy experiments for the first 30 days after publish
- Excludes deep technical integrations (connectors) — those live in the technical onboarding workbook (linked)

Quick TL;DR checklist (preflight)
- [ ] Partner manifest (SKU mapping + metering model) confirmed and signed by finance
- [ ] Short tile (<= 80 chars) and 3 headline bullets submitted to marketplace console
- [ ] Product trial entitlements and provisioning playbook uploaded to partner portal
- [ ] Security & data residency checklist complete (customer data flow diagram + KMS plan)
- [ ] Telemetry and purchase webhooks endpoint tested in staging (post-back + retry)
- [ ] SSO/SAML/OIDC flow validated with test tenant, docs attached
- [ ] Pricing and SKU test transactions executed (sandbox purchase)

Stakeholders & RACI (basic)
- Product: owner (Morgan) — final copy decisions, acceptance criteria
- Solutions Eng: implement entitlement flows + test purchases (Arjun)
- Legal/Finance: approve contract language and SKU mapping (Lina)
- Dev Rel / Docs: publish help links on tile and detail page (Tess)
- Partner rep: confirm customer-facing positioning + co-brand assets

Marketplace copy sandbox (use these variants in the console A/B experiments)
Short tile candidates (choose one or test AB):
- Redwood Inference — High-performance LLM inference (fast, reliable, economical)
- Run LLMs at scale with predictable latency and cost — Redwood Inference

30-word summary (detail page lead):
Redwood Inference provides a production-grade inference platform for text, chat, and embeddings. Choose hosted, dedicated, or private deployments with built-in rollout controls, telemetry, and cost-optimization tools.

Feature bullets (3–5):
- Production-grade latency and throughput: autoscaling GPU pools and runtime optimizations for consistent SLAs
- Unified API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments for simple dev experience
- Cost controls: batching, caching, and quantization recommendations that reduce per-token spend
- Observability & rollouts: per-model telemetry, tracing hooks, and canary/A-B rollout support

Call-to-action variants:
- Start a free trial — 30 minutes to hello world (best for PLG funnel)
- Request an enterprise demo and dedicated capacity plan
- Try in sandbox: provision a test instance (billing-free)

Acceptance criteria for listing to go live (detailed)
- Copy: final tile + long description approved by marketing and partner rep
- Legal: partner Addendum signed if required; marketplace contract variations reconciled
- Billing: SKU mapping confirmed and test invoices generated in sandbox
- Security: DAST scan passed; data flow doc + KMS proof-of-concept for private deployments
- Telemetry: purchase and usage webhooks validated, retries/logging instrumented
- Support: runbook for common failure modes and marketplace-specific incidents attached

Operational runway (day -14 to day +30)
- D-14: Finalize copy; attach help links; create partner ticket for certification
- D-10: Run sandbox purchases; complete legal signoff; QA SSO + provisioning
- D-5: Staging listing pushed to marketplace staging environment for vendor QA
- D-2: Smoke test full flow end-to-end (purchase -> entitle -> webhook -> usage)
- D+0: Publish listing (monitor purchase funnel and telemetry)
- D+1–D+7: High-frequency checks (hourly dashboards for first 24h, then every 4 hours)
- D+7–D+30: Copy A/B experiments live, gather conversion metrics, tweak tile/CTA

Rollback & incident playbook (short)
- Quick wins (if purchase failing): temporarily set listing to trial-only, disable billing SKU mapping and route customers to manual provisioning flow
- If webhook failure: enable Marketplace retry logs, and set up manual reconciliation for affected invoices for 48h (finance owns)
- If legal/billing term conflict discovered after publish: request temporary delisting and open Partner Remediation ticket; inform customers via support template

Common contract/billing quirks to watch for
- Marketplace metering vs. Redwood metering mismatch (units vs tokens): always map to an agreed conversion formula and publish in partner addendum
- Billing delays: some marketplaces batch invoices daily — plan for lead times and handle refunds via finance process
- Tax handling & VAT: confirm who is the seller of record for each marketplace (AWS vs partner)

Telemetry & instrumentation checklist
- Instrument token usage and request latency with trace IDs passed through marketplace purchase flow
- Capture marketplace purchase_id in our internal billing events for reconciliation
- Expose a partner-facing health endpoint (read-only) for marketplace certification teams

Copy experiment matrix (ideas to test)
- Variant A: Emphasize latency ("Predictable 95th percentile latency")
- Variant B: Emphasize cost ("Cut per-token cost with batching + cache")
- Variant C: Emphasize deployment flexibility ("Hosted, Dedicated, Private — same API")
Metrics to watch: click-through rate (tile -> detail), trial signup rate, sandbox provisioning success, 7-day retention of trial users

Notes to self / unresolved questions (working list)
- How to represent quantization recommendations in the tile without confusing non-technical buyers? Short -> probably not; put in detail page
- Do we need a separate SKU for dedicated burst capacity? finance question (Lina)
- Partner asset sizes: marketplace often restricts hero images to specific aspect ratio; need final art from design by D-10
- Who owns errors created by marketplace throttling? add to partner addendum

Resources & links (quick):
- Confluence: marketplace-integration-playbook (CONFLUENCE-4567)
- Jira: JIRA-GTM-1203 (publish + QA epic)
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integration/pull/87
- Slack: #marketplace-partners (use for vendor cert updates)

Final notes:
This doc is intentionally messy — use it as the single source of short-term truth during launch prep. Move finalized copy to the canonical copy repo (docs/marketing/marketplace-copy) and attach the signed SKU map to the partner contract folder.

TODOs (short):

- [ ] Engineering: add purchase_id to internal billing events (Arjun)
- [ ] Finance: confirm seller-of-record per region (Lina)
- [ ] PM: lock final CTA and schedule A/B experiment (Morgan)

Drafted by: Morgan Patel — notes, shorthand, experiments.
